experiment.title: Optimize one measured GPU operation
experiment.implementation: Design template only; target family is intentionally unset until diagnostic evidence is available.
experiment.hypothesis: One demonstrated expensive shape can use less dequantization/memory work or better cooperative matrix input.
experiment.only_change: One dispatch/kernel in an isolated engine, keeping GGUF bytes and fallback behavior.
prerequisites: Actual candidate patch, manifest and build receipt
proof: CPU-reference math, odd/aligned shapes and inactive-expert cases
Fresh ABBA model comparisons and semantic checks
Matched TPS, first-token and full-reply percentages
stop_if: Two narrow approaches repeatedly under 2-3 percent
experiment.limits: A synthetic kernel win is not a model TPS win. Do not force a sparse few-row workload into MMA merely because the hardware supports matrix acceleration.

comparison.adoption_gate: At least 5 percent median complete-task improvement on the chosen workload, or useful capacity gain with an explicitly accepted speed tradeoff; no unexplained quality failure or new swap. Report control drift and all raw passes.
comparison.percentage_rules: TPS gain = 100*(candidate/control-1). Time reduction = 100*(1-candidate/control). Requires finite positive matched metrics. Do not add percentages from separate experiments.
